database.legacyPolicy: never run the vNext chain on the legacy database

invariants: one account has at most one active member per system
every P1 system has exactly one active default tenant
every system context references the same system across member and tenant foreign keys
session and refresh tokens are stored only as hashes
refresh token rotation is single use and traceable by token family
permission and data-scope snapshots are persisted with the context session
soft-deleted or disabled accounts cannot authenticate

transactions.useCase: idempotent default platform super administrator bootstrap
transactions.commitResult: exactly one active admin platform super administrator exists
transactions.rollbackResult: no partial account or credential remains
transactions.repeatRule: never duplicate the account and never reset an existing password

transactions.commitResult: account can enter the created system as its system super administrator
transactions.rollbackResult: forced failure leaves none of the account, system, tenant, member, role or session rows
transactions.repeatRule: same idempotency key returns the original committed result

transactions.commitResult: one active context and one usable refresh token are issued
transactions.rollbackResult: failed authentication issues no usable token

transactions.commitResult: persisted context has the exact system, tenant, member, roles, data scope and permission snapshot
transactions.rollbackResult: unauthorized or inconsistent scope issues no system context

defaultAdministrator.bootstrap: application use case using generated Base services
defaultAdministrator.evidenceRule: plaintext password is forbidden in logs, responses and evidence

migrationGate: all foreign keys and unique keys in this contract exist
deferred tables are absent from the final P1 migration
Base code is generated from the accepted P1 schema
